cohort.axis_rule: Each drawn identity is assigned one axis; identities are drawn from the eligible pool in ascending id order and the axis sequence is shuffled by the same seeded generator.

seat_substitutions.bias: gpt-6-luna completes at 0.50 USD/Mtok against gpt-5.6-luna's 0.60 at the same prompt rate, so the substitute over-states this seat and the incumbent arm reads high by whatever the recorded token mix spends on output tokens.

No gpt-6.1-sol review_receipt exists. The arm carries no cycle-2 cost for the docs axis and therefore under-states it; the substitute used for the headline figure is the gpt-5.5 escalator receipt, whose recorded mean is 2.8 times the cycle-1 seat. The headline therefore brackets rather than pins the docs escalator.

wall_plan.split: Serial, one worker: the incumbent arm is the long pole because its escalator adds a third call on roughly a quarter of items. Run the two axes as separate work items, and where the incumbent arm exceeds one hour, split it by axis and run the docs half as its own item -- the two axes share no seat and no cohort item.
